sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics

Wobbly Boxing's core gameplay mechanics are centered around throwing punches and dodging attacks. Players can move their character left or right using the arrow keys or touch controls, and jump or throw punches using the space bar or tap buttons. The game's physics engine is designed to be unpredictable, making each match a unique and exciting experience. One of the key features of Wobbly Boxing's gameplay mechanics is the use of 'jumps' and 'throws.' Players can jump into the air to avoid incoming punches or throw punches at their opponent while they're airborne. Another important aspect of Wobbly Boxing's gameplay mechanics is the use of 'energy.' Players have a limited amount of energy that they can use to throw punches and dodge attacks. Overall, Wobbly Boxing's core gameplay mechanics are simple yet deep, offering a fun and challenging experience for players of all ages and skill levels.
